entries.subject: identity-source-conflict
entries.text: The console authenticates only a per-launch bearer token and static/navigation_ui.js explicitly records that no username/role authorization model exists and forbids implying one before DEPLOY.1A OIDC/RBAC. Which authoritative source should provide the connected username and role for this movement, or should the movement be deferred until that boundary exists?

entries.subject: Redirecting to ui2 application
entries.text: The scope is for the ui2 React application under ui2/frontend/, not the legacy static/navigation_ui.js. The ui2 frontend already receives roles in the API (e.g. from /session/status or similar) and currently renders a raw enum string like 'role:viewer, role:operator' in the top right. Find the relevant React component in ui2/frontend/src/shell/, extract the username and parse the roles to show a clean label. Do not touch static/navigation_ui.js.
